versions.changelog:
Memphis Cognitive Engine v3.7.2

- Added new file: _meta.json for enhanced metadata support.
- No functional or feature changes to the skill itself. 
- The package remains a documentation-only meta-package.

**Major update: Memphis Cognitive Engine is now the only actively maintained skill. All other Memphis skills are deprecated.**

- Added clear notice that memphis-cognitive is the MAIN and ONLY supported Memphis skill; others are deprecated.
- Updated documentation to highlight consolidation to a single skill for all users (2026-03-05).
- No changes to commands or features; still 100% production ready with all core and advanced features.
- Existing installation and usage instructions remain unchanged.

- Version bump from 3.6.5 to 3.7.2.
- Documentation updated: SKILL.md now reflects latest version, features, and binary build availability (Linux, macOS, Windows).
- Added QUICKSTART.md for improved onboarding and quick reference.
- Status and feature sections updated for current release.
- No breaking changes or new commands; package remains a meta-package (documentation only).

memphis-cognitive v3.6.5

- Designated the skill as a META-PACKAGE (documentation only); Memphis CLI must now be installed separately.
- Updated installation instructions for clarity, including curl one-liner and step-by-step options.
- Added explicit warning about Memphis CLI requirement at the top of documentation.
- Minor clarifications and formatting improvements throughout setup and usage guides.

Memphis Cognitive Engine v3.6.3

- Production-ready AI memory system with 17 fully working commands and zero critical bugs.
- Three decision models: manual capture, git-based inference, and predictive decision support.
- Advanced features: TUI dashboard, knowledge graph, reflection engine, trade protocol, and multi-agent sync.
- Supports developers and teams with privacy-first, local-first, and multi-agent knowledge management.
- Improved documentation and quick start instructions for fast onboarding.

**v2.2.0 is a major upgrade – completes all 3 cognitive models (manual, inference, predictive):**

- Adds full support for Model C: Predictive Decisions – Memphis can now learn your patterns and proactively suggest likely next decisions.
- Documentation updated and reorganized: clear quick start, full command reference, and real-world scenarios for each model.
- Expanded features: pattern learning, proactive suggestions, and accuracy tracking included with Model C.
- New tags and improved summaries to highlight use cases, target audiences, and integration steps.
- Enhanced agent identity example for OpenClaw SOUL.md, supporting agent-level personalization and prediction workflows.
Bug fix: Added -t, --tags option to CLI

**Major update introducing Decision-First AI memory and advanced agent features**

- Reimagined Memphis as a cognitive engine focusing on tracking, revising, and reflecting on decisions.
- Introduced structured decision lifecycle, memory ledger (blockchain), and agent-powered inference.
- New commands for decision capture, revision, reflection analysis, journaling, semantic search, and passive data collection.
- Added integration layers: offline LLM, agent runtime, rich CLI/TUI interface, and memory graph visualization.
- Advanced features: coding task generation from memory, intelligent learning statistics, multi-agent trade network, MCP tool integration.
- Extensive documentation, architecture and command examples included.
